description: This file defines utility functions for creating webhook procedures with permission checks, including a main PBAC-based procedure and a legacy fallback, used for authorization in webhook management within a TRPC server context.

classes.name: PermissionCheckService
classes.description: Service for checking user permissions within PBAC system.

methods.name: createWebhookPbacProcedure
methods.description: Creates a TRPC procedure that enforces PBAC permissions for webhooks, with input validation and permission checks based on webhook ID, team ID, or event type ID.

methods.name: webhookProcedure
methods.description: Legacy webhook procedure that uses the 'webhook.update' permission, maintaining backward compatibility.
